title: Build for Auckland: Build Night with Base44 🚀

description:
**What can you build for Auckland in one evening?**
Join Auckland AI Meetup, Startup Club NZ, and the wider Auckland startup community for a hands-on evening where we turn real problems into working apps and AI agents.
This is not an evening of sitting through talks. You’ll actually build something.
Whether you're a developer, designer, founder, student, product person, AI enthusiast—or simply someone with an idea—you’re welcome. The **top five teams** will pitch their solutions on stage, and the top three teams will share a **NZ$1,200 prize pool**.

👉 Important: Please register through the official event page to secure your place.
RSVP here: [https://www.aucklandstartupweek.com/programme-2026/build-for-auckland-base-44-build-night](https://www.aucklandstartupweek.com/programme-2026/build-for-auckland-base-44-build-night)

**💡 How it works**
You do not need to arrive with a team or even an idea.
We'll have real Auckland challenges submitted by the community. Pick a problem you care about, meet other participants, and form a team of up to four people.

**Choose a challenge → Form a team → Build → Demo → Pitch**
Teams will receive a short challenge brief and a starting Base44 prompt, then use Base44 to rapidly build a working app or AI agent.
Industry mentors will be around during the evening to help you develop the idea, solve problems, and turn your prototype into something compelling.
There will also be a short workshop exploring an important question:

**You've built a prototype. Could this become a real, sustainable business?**
**🏆 Build it. Pitch it. Maybe keep building it.**
At the end of the build session, teams submit their prototypes for judging.
The **top five teams** will pitch their solutions on stage, and the top three teams will share a **NZ$1,200 prize pool**.

title: Agentic Engineering Day New Zealand
description:
Hi all,

We’re excited to bring [Agentic Engineering Day to New Zealand](https://www.agenticbuild.day/) this October 21–22, 2026 in Auckland.

Agentic Engineering Day is an independent, community-driven conference for software engineers, architects, builders, and curious minds exploring what it really means to work with AI systems in practice. From agents and emerging standards like MCP, SKILLS, to orchestration, evaluation, governance, observability & tracing, security, memory & context management and infrastructure - this is about the messy, real-world challenges of moving Cognitive Architectures out of the lab and into hardened, reliable production systems.

Whether you're experimenting with your first agent or scaling complex AI systems, this is a space to learn, share, and help shape the future of the local industry - together.

**Note:** Make sure to register to secure your seat! There is limited space available.

**[Agentic Engineering Day](https://www.agenticengineering.day/) (formerly Agentic Build Day)** is a paid event with community-priced tickets. Join us and support!

**Call for papers OPEN!**

If you're building agentic systems, shipping them into production, or pushing the boundaries of what autonomous AI can do, we want to hear about it.

Share what you're learning with the community and let’s build the future of agentic systems together.

Submissions are open now → https://www.agenticengineering.day/

**Talk 1: Finding Joy After AI: An Inside Out Look at How We Work by Kevin Meneses**
Inspired by Disney and Pixar's Inside Out films, this (pre-recorded) talk uses their premise as a framework to explore what team survey data reveals about AI adoption, productivity, and working hours, offering practical ways to thrive in an AI-assisted workflow.

**A bit about Kevin:**

* Kevin is a Junior Software Engineer at Fergus who transitioned into engineering from the Customer Support team after completing a full stack developer programme.

**Talk 2: Building AI without Losing Our Values by**
**Lauren Peate**
AI is here to stay – hype, copyright theft, data worker mistreatment, environmental harm, and all. If you care about people and the planet but also need to understand new tech, what can you do? I’ll recommend a middle ground – using AI in features and workflows without compromising our values. Combining my own experience with insights from our original research with hundreds of global developers, I’ll share examples of how to use this tech with care.

**A bit about Lauren:**

* Lauren Peate is a data nerd who cares about people. She’s founder and CEO of Multitudes, which turns engineering metrics into a tool for continuous improvement – in AI, engineering productivity, developer experience, and more. Through her career, she’s worked with a wide range of organizations, from Fortune 500 tech companies in San Francisco to startups in the Middle East. Previously on a PhD track, she started her career conducting independent research through a Fulbright grant.

title: Who Are We Building For? Product and Sales on ICP and UVP
description:
Sales says Product isn't building what customers need. Product says Sales is promising features that don't exist. Both may be right, and both may be missing the real problem: they're trying to understand the customer separately.

In this session, Ren will draw on 30 years in tech sales to show why your Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) and Unique Value Proposition (UVP) work best when Product and Sales develop them together. Strategy should start with the market opportunity and the client, not with product ideation or features.

This won't be a one-way talk. Ren will share real stories and use cases from enterprise deals, including how shared customer evidence turned a single client request into a roadmap priority. We'll also run a hands-on workshop on UVP frameworks, so you can practise turning "here's what our product does" into "here's your situation and what changes."

You'll walk away with:

\- A clearer view of who Product and Sales should each define in an ICP\, and where they should work together
\- A way to tell a one\-off feature request from a real market signal
\- Turn product features into a buyer\-focused UVP

Who it's for: Product managers and product leaders, and anyone who works closely with Sales or customers.

Huge thanks to Auror for hosting and sponsoring this event!

You can join the livestream here: [https://meet.google.com/npk-dmyt-ddj](https://meet.google.com/npk-dmyt-ddj). As always the livestream will kick off from just before 6pm.

Note that our host venue has asked that we send you the exact location of the event on the day a couple of hours before the start time - the venue is in the Britomart area. Those of you who have attended events at Auror before will know where it is!

title: Your AI Agent Just Got a Job. Does It Have an ID Badge?
description:
AI agents are no longer just a future idea. They're already reading emails, accessing files and taking actions inside businesses every day.

Here's the catch: when a new employee joins, they get an ID badge, a manager and limited access. When an AI agent joins, it often gets none of that.

No clear owner, no tracking, and no one noticing when it's still running long after it's needed.

In this session, we'll break it down in plain English:

* **Why this matters:** what can go wrong when AI agents work without proper identity and oversight
* **How Microsoft is tackling it:** meet **Microsoft Entra Agent ID**, which gives every AI agent its own identity
* **The "Blueprint" idea:** think of it as a template that sets the rules once, so every agent built from it follows them
* **Keeping humans in charge:** making sure every agent has someone accountable for it

No deep technical background needed. If you use, build or worry about AI at work, this one's for you.

\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-

**Susantha Silva** is a Solutions Architect working at CyberCX and an active Microsoft Trainer. Experience around Azure Cloud security, Defender solutions and Microsoft Purview.

He specialises in helping enterprises design, assess, and strengthen their cloud security posture through Microsoft-native technologies.

**Nuwan Chinthaka** is a Cloud Architect working at Umbrellar Technology Group and a Microsoft Certified Trainer (MCT) with 10+ years of Microsoft Azure experience across APAC. Specializing in Azure, Microsoft Entra and Microsoft Security Solutions.

**Rory Braybrook** is an independent Microsoft Identity Consultant and a Microsoft MVP.

title: Arrival
location: 2 Freyberg Place, Auckland CBD, Auckland 1000, New Zealand, Auckland
description:
Over the years that we have been showing films at the EMC, we have let our Sci-Fi members down somewhat. And I confess - I am not into Sci Fi. Too many space ships and odd looking aliens I thought

Well, sic-fi can be immensely satisfying and thought provoking. Now we start to make up for avoiding such films! Alien space ships land around the globe and an expert linguist is hired to work out whether the aliens have come in peace or not.

The film was nominated for best picture, best performance by the lead actress and best original score for a film (I don't remember showing a film nominated for this award)

The Telegraph (UK) reviewer wrote: "introspective, philosophical and existentially inclined—yet [it] unfolds in an unwavering tenor of chest-tightening excitement. And there is a mid-film revelation—less a sudden twist than sleek unwinding of everything you think you know—that feels, when it hits you, like your seat is tipping back.

Definitely worth the look!
